'''August 2004 Fort Worth tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 8 August 2004 at 12:00 PM at Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3758-51397">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51397#51397 Texas Tournament on 08/08/2004], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040913000519/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3758%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed Swiss tournament with an unlimited card pool, of two or three rounds and no final confrontation. The buy-in was $5 or more, and the announced prizes were three uncut sheets, three booster boxes and six tournament foils.<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 August 2004<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool; Swiss, two or three rounds<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />
* '''Entry:''' $5 or more<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-3758-51397" />

== Results ==
